---
title: "Working group meeting: tiers paper progress and a new member"
date: 2026-09-28
description: "Matrix nearly final, terminology settled, and plans for the website."
categories: [Meeting notes, Tiers of LCA]
---

Highlights from our biweekly working group meeting:

- **Welcome.** A sustainability director from the flooring industry joined the group, bringing a sector perspective we have not had before. Flooring has been an early adopter of supply chain specific LCA.
- **Tiers paper.** The uncertainty indicator is now drafted in the matrix and will be discussed at the next meeting. The group agreed to use "multifunctional" rather than "multi-product" systems. The final matrix will be circulated for sign-off, and the case study selection and target audience are being revisited.
- **Website.** The group agreed to build a website so work can be shared earlier and updated often, rather than waiting on journal publication.
- **Subgroups.** The AI subgroup continues to meet on alternate weeks; the design flexibility subgroup is recruiting members.
